title: Mortgage fraud cases increase across all categories
summary:
Mortgage fraud has increased across all reported categories in the first half of 2026, according to data from fraud prevention service Cifas. The figures show mortgage application identity fraud rose by 36% compared with the same period in 2025.

title: ValPal adds seller price expectation tool for agents
summary:
Property valuation platform ValPal has introduced a feature allowing homeowners to share their own price expectations alongside online valuation enquiries, giving estate agents advance insight into seller expectations before market appraisals.

title: Bellway launches rebrand as housebuilder turns 80
summary:
Bellway has introduced updated branding to mark its 80th year in operation, with the refreshed identity now being rolled out across its digital platforms and development sites. The new branding will appear on several North East developments this month.

title: London renters now require £75,000 salary to meet affordability
summary:
The annual salary required to secure an average rental property in London has reached £74,520, according to new data from Propertymark. The increase follows a 4.2% month-on-month rise in average rents across the capital, climbing from £2,385 to £2,484.

title: Stoke-on-Trent introduces strict HMO controls
summary:
Stoke-on-Trent City Council has announced comprehensive regulatory measures targeting houses in multiple occupation, introducing ward-level caps and planning restrictions. The council has implemented an Article 4 Direction removing permitted development rights for converting family homes into HMOs.

title: Birmingham student lettings agency adopts CRM platform
summary:
House Hunt, a student lettings agency based in Selly Oak, Birmingham, has implemented Alto's property management CRM system to replace manual processes and fragmented data management. The agency manages over 1,000 properties, with around 300 currently under management.

title: Leasehold flats struggle to sell across England
summary:
Data from Zoopla shows 80.5% of leasehold flats listed for sale in England in 2025 remain unsold after six months. London records the highest rate at 87%, with pricing mismatches between investors and first-time buyers contributing to market stagnation.

title: £15.9m facility funds 35-home later living scheme
summary:
Paragon Development Finance has provided £15.9 million in funding for the acquisition and development of a 35-home later living scheme in Hartley Wintney, Hampshire. The facility represents the FTSE 250 lender's third transaction with SME developer Beechcroft.

title: Tenancy fraud exposes rental sector to £4.1bn annual risk
summary:
Fraudulent tenancy applications could expose the UK's private rented sector to £4.1bn in direct financial losses annually, according to analysis of more than one million tenant references. Research by Goodlord found 41 applications per 1,000 references were flagged for suspected fraud between July 2025 and June 2026.

title: UK house prices stagnate in July amid mortgage rate pressures
summary:
UK house prices remained broadly flat in July as higher mortgage rates and stretched affordability continued to constrain buyer activity, according to Lloyds Banking Group's monthly index. The average property price stood at £299,253 in July, with annual growth registering just 0.1%, marking the weakest rate since November 2023.
